meta.title: WorkBuddy Credits (dsh-workbuddy-billing)
meta.description: Shows the credits this turn spent and the credits remaining under every assistant reply. Reads the real upstream balance delta when available (measured) and falls back to a token × credit-multiplier estimate otherwise (estimated).
turn.estimatedHint: The upstream balance is unavailable, so this figure is estimated from tokens × the model's credit multiplier. It may differ from what is actually billed.
turn.tokensHint: Input {input} · cache read {cacheRead} · cache write {cacheWrite} · output {output}
turn.unavailable: Credit data is unavailable right now
settings.enabled.description: Show this turn's spend and the remaining credits under every assistant reply. When off, nothing is collected and no routes are registered.
settings.region.description: Which WorkBuddy region to read the balance from: cn = mainland China, global = international.
settings.refreshSeconds.description: How long a balance sample stays cached, in seconds. Each turn start and end forces a fresh sample; this only affects the UI's polling rate.
settings.showWhenEstimated.description: When the upstream balance is unavailable, still show the token-based estimate. Turn this off to show only "data unavailable".
settings.priceBasis.description: The conversion constant used by the estimate: credits per single token at credit multiplier 1.0. Default 0.0001 (100 credits per million tokens). Recalibrate this if you know your real billing rate.
settings.modelCatalog.description: Per-model credit-multiplier overrides keyed by model id, for example {"deepseek-v4.1-flash": 0.11}. Overrides win over the built-in catalog.
settings.defaultCreditMultiplier.descrip: The credit multiplier to assume for a model that is not in the catalog.
settings.hostOrigin.description: Origin of the host serving the upstream plugin, for example http://127.0.0.1:8495. Leave empty to infer it from the request or the environment; you normally do not need to set this.
settings.sessionEvents.description: Subscribe to the host's session event stream to detect each turn's start and end automatically. Only turn this off if that detection misbehaves (the browser half then reports turns instead).
turn.sharedAccountHint: The balance moved by more than this turn's tokens could explain, which means the account is also being used elsewhere (another computer or client). That delta is not this turn's cost, so the token-based estimate is shown instead.
turn.noTokensHint: No token usage was recorded for this turn (no model calls, or the events were not observed), so no reliable figure is available.
